title: Multi Delay ülejäänud 31 Type malli (multidelayTypes): laadimine, lugemine, kuulamine
method: FM3_SHOT_LOAD.py --load --preset ID sends one generated preset to the edit buffer (7F 00) and reads the Multi Delay record (74) with fn=0x1F (read-only), word for word against the generated file; FM3-Edit Type names are read without saving and the user listens to scenes 1..4. Nothing is stored or set.

items.name: T49A MD TYPES
items.question: Holds the FM3 all generated Multi Delay words? FM3-Edit Type per channel = A Quad-Tap Delay / B Quad Parallel Delay / C Quad Series Delay / D Quad Diffusor? Scenes 1..4 sound like those Types?
